mission_10: This capstone mission combines all dimensionality reduction techniques into a comprehensive comparison pipeline. You will apply PCA (unsupervised variance maximization), LDA (supervised class separation), SelectKBest (univariate statistical selection), and RFE (recursive wrapper selection) to the same dataset. By comparing the output shapes, feature selections, and characteristics of each method, you will develop an intuitive understanding of when to use each technique. This holistic view of dimensionality reduction methods is essential for making informed preprocessing decisions in real-world machine learning projects.
